set: A: surface and detail, the ten keys whole

issues.where: the clear ball, centre of the office tier, between the green and blue inserts
issues.what: the arrow inside the ball reads as a crumpled, lumpy white wad with a shapeless grey smear hanging off its lower left, not as a clean solid cursor arrow; noticeable on the still without zooming
issues.fix: remodel the enclosed arrow as a crisp flat-sided solid with bevelled edges and a single gloss pass, and clear the stray grey blob inside the sphere

issues.where: the clear ball resting on the green envelope insert, centre-left
issues.what: the arrow inside is a dark, partially formed blob and the sphere has a small dangling grey smear at its right rim, so the ball reads as a dirty bubble rather than a clear ball with a solid arrow inside
issues.fix: re-render the ball with the arrow fully formed and well lit, and remove the rim smear

issues.where: the ball on the wire ramp, centre frame
issues.what: close up, the arrow's broad faces are flat matte white with a drawn outline feel; its thickness reads only at the tail, so it flirts with the flat-white-shape-with-outline giveaway
issues.fix: give the arrow consistent edge bevels and a subtle specular gradient across its top face so it reads as a solid at every size

issues.where: the diverter housing hanging from the wire ramp, upper centre-left, and the floor just right of the ball
issues.what: the diverter is a plain untextured grey box with no seams, screws or label, like an unfinished placeholder block, and the ball's contact is a detached fuzzy dark blob floating clear of the sphere
issues.fix: add panel seams, fasteners and a paint finish to the housing, and ground the ball with a tight contact shadow that touches it

issues.where: the upper-left tier floor, between the left tube rail and the Corporate HQ tier
issues.what: long strips of bare, unprinted dark floor with no inserts, posts or lamps; the one area of the machine that reads empty and unfinished
issues.fix: add lane guides, a couple of standup targets or inserts and printed lane art so the strip carries the same density as the rest of the playfield
